output.summary: An annual or perennial herb or woody-based subshrub, likely native to West Africa. Its pale flowers have a dark red spot, while the calyx becomes fleshy and deep crimson as the fruit matures. The calyces are commonly steeped for an infusion, and the stems yield fibre.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves, young stems and fruits are cooked; calyces and fruits make drinks, and the fruits can be made into jam.
